title: Trombonists in Fletcher Henderson's band
summary: He heard Higginbotham, Sandy Williams, Claude Jones in a wig, Rex Stewart and Jimmy Harrison.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Were there any (Inaudible) in any trombone players in any of those bands that you particularly enjoyed?

Yeah. Fletcher had some very good trombone players. He had J. C. Higginbotham and he had Sandy Williams -- was with that band. And Claude Jones was on that band. Claude Jones, ever since I've known him, he wore a wig, you know.

And he used to get loaded; that thing would turn around backwards and just look all kind of funny ways. And Rex Stewart was playing in -- I first heard Rex before he was with Duke. Rex was with Fletcher, I think, when I first heard him, before he was with Duke, and Rex used to come through there a lot, and a lot of name musicians -- lot of good trombone players used to come through there.

Jimmy -- Jimmy Harris, oh he used to come through there with Fletcher before. Coleman Hawkins, of course, was with Fletcher in those days when they'd come through, and they were all -- they were all young then. They're pretty young now.
